name: P-51 Mustang
summary: Iconic WWII long-range escort fighter with a Merlin V-12; the most numerous fighter warbird flying in the US.

wings: Low, laminar-flow wing with a straight leading edge and squared tips
engines: Liquid-cooled inline V-12 with a long pointed nose
Large radiator scoop under the belly behind the cockpit
fuselage: Bubble canopy (D/K) or framed canopy with a razorback rear deck (B/C)
tail: Fin with dorsal fillet on the D model

tellTales: Big air scoop under the belly behind the cockpit
Long pointed inline-engine nose with a four-blade prop
Bubble canopy on a slim single-seat fighter

confusedWith.howToTell: The P-40's radiator scoop is under the nose right behind the prop; the P-51's scoop is under the belly behind the cockpit.
The T-28 has a round radial nose and tricycle gear; the P-51 has a pointed inline nose and a tailwheel.
The Sea Fury has a big radial nose with a smooth round cowl and a five-blade propeller; the Mustang has a pointed inline nose and a belly scoop.
The Thunderbolt is much bigger with a barrel-shaped fuselage, a round radial nose and an oval chin intake; the Mustang is slim with a pointed inline nose and a belly scoop.
